corpus_crossquery.query: Which registry records already cite this paper, and does the primary say what they say it says?
corpus_crossquery.finding: PAPER 045, CORPUS P356, LIT-0356, CLAIM 001, CLAIM 031, CLAIM 032, DL-MECH-038/039/040/045. Most wording holds; CLAIM 031 drops the qualifier 'in some of these cases'; PAPER 045 calls the 23 tabulated cases 'reported' though two are this paper's own; CLAIM 032 uses it for clinically well carrier parents, which it never examines.
